subject: Results recap and quick quote ask — Veridian Retail PoC
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Turner <leah.turner@veridianretail.com>, Omar Salcedo <omar@veridianretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Results recap and quick quote ask — Veridian Retail PoC

Hi Leah / Omar,

Thanks again for partnering with us on the two-week PoC. I pulled together a short recap of the outcomes (attached) but wanted to surface the highlights here so we can quickly capture a customer blurb if you’re comfortable: 

- End-to-end 95th-percentile latency improvement: down ~38% (from 420ms -> 260ms) for the recommendation service under production-like load.
- Effective throughput increase: ~2.6x at target QPS due to smarter batching and prefix caching.
- Token/unit cost reduction: ~21% after moving to the quantized model profile plus caching.
- No observable regression on sample QA prompts we tracked; precision on A/B prompt set held within ±1.5% (see Appendix B).

I attached the PoC results PDF (veridian_poc_results_2027-11-27.pdf) and a one-pager we’d use for a short case highlight. Would you be open to:

1) A one-sentence quote we can include in a short customer spotlight (we’ll attribute name + title) and
2) Permission to use the Veridian Retail logo on the case asset (we can provide versioning and final approval before publish)?

If it helps, we can do a 15-minute sync next week to draft the quote together — I’m available Tue/Wed afternoon PST.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: veridian_poc_results_2027-11-27.pdf, redwood_onepager_v1.pdf
From: Leah Turner <leah.turner@veridianretail.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Omar Salcedo <omar@veridianretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Results recap and quick quote ask — Veridian Retail PoC

Hi Camila (and team),

Really impressed with the outcome — the latency and throughput gains are material for our recommender service and should help with peak conversions this season. Omar and I reviewed the PDF. A couple quick notes:

- We’re happy to provide a short quote for the spotlight. For public-facing assets we’d prefer to avoid exact dollar figures or highly specific per-token cost numbers, but performance and percent improvements are fine.
- For logo use, I need a quick marketing consent form signed off internally; I can get that routed this week.

Here’s a one-line quote you can start with; feel free to tweak for tone: 

"Working with Redwood Inference reduced our recommendation latency by nearly 40% and increased throughput, letting us serve personalized experiences faster across peak windows."

If you want to draft a framed sentence with our attribution, use: "— Leah Turner, VP Product, Veridian Retail"

I can do a 15-minute call on Wed (Dec 1) at 1:30pm PST to finalize wording and confirm logo permissions.

Thanks,
Leah

--
Leah Turner
VP, Product | Veridian Retail
leah.turner@veridianretail.com | +1 617-555-0142

- Ben: I’ll drop this into the HubSpot opportunity (VER-2391) and queue a short collateral update. Once Leah signs the consent, we’ll publish the mini-spotlight and push a quick social snippet.
